answer.answer: AB-PMJAY provides an annual hospitalization cover of ₹5,00,000 per eligible family per year [E01][E02]. This cashless coverage includes secondary and tertiary hospitalization and covers comprehensive treatment costs including consultation, medicines, diagnostics, surgery, ICU, implants, accommodation, and food, as well as 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses [E02].
